# Social Media Operations & Algorithm Management

## Overview
Social Media Operations at Digital Transition Marketing are managed by Neon Vision through an autonomous, API-driven infrastructure. The system orchestrates multi-platform deployment across LinkedIn, TikTok, Instagram, and emerging channels, ensuring content reaches precise audience segments while maintaining consistency and timing.

## Automated Posting & Scheduling
- Content scheduling is fully automated, integrating with internal and third-party APIs for cross-platform publishing.  
- Employee advocacy programs are managed via API pipelines, automatically amplifying organizational content across networks.  
- Automated triggers handle campaigns, promotions, and event-driven posts with dynamic adjustments based on real-time engagement data.

## 24/7 Moderation & Community Response
